name: @noamjose/schemasure

tools.name: extract_to_schema
tools.description: Turn messy text/HTML into guaranteed schema-valid JSON, or pay nothing. Calls the hosted SchemaSure API: output is guaranteed to validate against your JSON Schema (Ajv, draft 2020-12) or you get a typed error and are not charged (charge-only-on-success). Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base); the first few calls per client are free. No signup or API keys. Benchmarked 100% schema-valid with ~0.99 field F1 and zero hallucinations across a 10-doc-type corpus (11 items, incl. an adversarial prompt-injection tier), p50 latency ~1.5s. Evidence: /.well-known/benchmarks.json. Use whenever you need unstructured text/HTML turned into JSON matching a specific shape — invoices, receipts, resumes, product/HTML pages, logs, or anything you can describe as a schema. Tip: add a per-field description to your schema for best accuracy.

input.description: Raw unstructured content to extract from (plain text or HTML).

inputType.description: How to interpret `input`: plain text, HTML, or auto-detect (default).

schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) that the returned `data` is guaranteed to satisfy.

strict.description: Drop fields not present in the schema.
